glosses: protein (one of three major classes of food)
protein (a large, complex molecule composed of long chains of amino acids)

examples.text: Carne e ovos têm muitas de proteínas.
examples.en: Meat and eggs have a lot of protein.

examples.text: Os ovos são uma boa fonte de proteína?
examples.en: Are eggs a good source of protein?

examples.text: Carne e ovos têm um monte de proteínas.
examples.en: Meat and eggs have a lot of protein.

examples.text: Frango, atum e soja são boas fontes de proteína.
examples.en: Chicken, tuna and soybeans are good sources of protein.
